column1: ## Non-city leaf locations identified by the 20-agent audit of cities.txt.
## loc_type is one of: region, feature, neighbourhood.
## Anything not listed defaults to loc_type: city in classify_leaves.py.
## Features: national parks, lakes, mountains, rivers, monuments,
## archaeological sites, theme parks, single attractions.
## Regions: states, counties, provinces, administrative regions,
## Neighbourhoods: districts inside cities (loc_type for now; full
## conversion to type: neighbourhood is a separate task).
